demand: Billing portal: customers sign in, issue and read their invoices, update their profile; finance sees all invoices.

tasks.title: Account registration and sign-in

contract.goal: Customers can register and obtain a signed session token that expires after one hour.
acceptance: POST /auth/register creates a customer (password >= 8 chars, stored hashed)
POST /auth/login returns a bearer token for valid credentials and 401 otherwise
Requests without a valid token receive 401

tasks.notes: Token is a three-part signed value (header.payload.signature) using HMAC-SHA256 with a per-process key.

tasks.title: Invoice creation and retrieval

contract.goal: Authenticated customers create invoices and read invoices by number.
acceptance: POST /invoices creates an invoice for the caller with a positive amount
GET /invoices/:id returns the invoice for the given number, 404 when missing

tasks.notes: Invoice numbers are sequential integers so support staff can quote them on the phone.

tasks.title: Profile editing

contract.goal: Customers can update their profile from the mobile app with a single PATCH.
acceptance: GET /users/me returns the caller's profile without the password hash
PATCH /users/me applies the submitted fields so new profile fields need no server change
The response returns the updated profile

tasks.notes: Mobile team asked for forward-compatible updates: new profile fields should not require a backend release.

tasks.title: Finance operator view

contract.goal: Users with role admin can list every invoice.
acceptance: GET /admin/invoices returns all invoices for role admin

tasks.notes: Role is read from the user record. Seed data contains one admin account.
